name: vue-source-jump
description: Vue2/Vue3 Ctrl+Click 跳转插件，支持 import、Vite alias、tsconfig paths、组件、template/script 跳转。
author: rwerplus

commands.title: Vue Source Jump: Show Debug Info

vueSourceJump.enableComponentTags.description: Enable Ctrl+Click from Vue template component tags to component files.

vueSourceJump.enableTemplateSymbols.description: Enable Ctrl+Click from Vue template identifiers to same-file script definitions.

vueSourceJump.enableFileLineLinks.description: Enable Ctrl+Click on file:line and file:line:column references.

vueSourceJump.enableImportSources.description: Enable Ctrl+Click on import/export/require source strings, including Vite and tsconfig path aliases.

vueSourceJump.aliases.description: Workspace-root-relative aliases used when resolving component imports and file links.

vueSourceJump.componentSearchRoots.description: Workspace-relative folders scanned for auto-imported Vue components.

vueSourceJump.maxWorkspaceSearchResults.description: Maximum files returned per workspace component search pattern.

vueSourceJump.excludeDirectories.description: Directory names ignored by workspace searches such as auto component lookup. Build output directories like dist are excluded by default.

scripts.test: node test/resolver.test.js && node test/templateExpressions.test.js && node test/symbolGraph.test.js && node test/importUsage.test.js
